edits.text: When a user request involves multiple items, check if there is a single order that contains all of those items before splitting the requests across different orders.
edits.reason: This ensures the agent correctly identifies when a request applies to a single order rather than splitting it incorrectly.

edits.text: When the user asks to exchange an item in a pending order, load the retail:modify skill.
edits.reason: This ensures the agent loads the correct skill and policy for exchange requests on pending orders.

edits.text: After obtaining the user's confirmation for a summary of modification details, the agent must ensure the database tool calls match the items and options confirmed in that summary.
edits.reason: This prevents the agent from performing actions that contradict the details the user specifically confirmed.
